headline: A light lather, then a hydrating after-feel
subhead: Rub into a light lather in wet hands, massage into the face, then rinse thoroughly.
proof_points: Panthenol (Vitamin B5) and Allantoin for a hydrating after-feel
footnote: 4.1 out of 5 stars from 2,732 reviews on beminimalist.co, captured 2026-10-02
layout_description: Left column: large strength figure and active name, then headline, subhead and up to three proof points; the AI-generated person scene (person_prompt) is the human cue and carries the AI-GENERATED — ILLUSTRATIVE mark top-right; real pack shot composited in the right 45%; rating line in the footnote band, CTA bottom-left.
image_prompt: Empty background scene only: a calm off-white tile surface with a few faint beads of water along the lower edge, soft daylight from the upper left. Off-white, soft natural light, few props, clinical minimal style. Square 1080x1080. Keep the right 45% of the frame as an empty clear space, evenly lit, reserved for a pack photo placed later, and keep the left 50% calm and low-detail, reserved for copy added later. No product, no bottle, no packaging, no text, no letters, no logos, no people, no faces, no skin, no hands.
adaptation_notes: Angle: sensorial, from the page's usage and after-feel facts only: light lather (F13), hydrating after-feel (F7, quoted without the zinc/anti-bacterial wording), mild sulfate-free surfactants (F8). Kept: close hand-level application framing (Chemist at Play), in-use moment as the visual cue (Foxtale). Dropped: timed-fix headline, '#1 daily duo', sebum, acne-fighting and pore wording from F2/F3/F5. The person is AI-generated (High risk, labelled); a real application photo would lower the risk. Rating in the footnote slot.
